# Free DRAM gap

3,383,948 bytes reserved behind the first resource record and unused by the firmware; OMKit loads CORE.BIN and modules here.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0xa3456d74` to `0xa3791000` (runtime uncached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

Its size depends on this version's resources. OMKit reads CORE.BIN to 0xa345a000 (at most 3 MiB) and runs it through the cached view at 0x6345a010. Only 0xa3470000..0xa3780000 was pattern-tested on the camera.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)): Reserved for resource record 0 (length 0x3c5d74); the next record starts at 0xa3791000. Source: [OM-5 Mark II 1.1 system catalogue](../sources/omkit.system.md).
- **Emulator** ([OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)): No firmware access to the gap in the emulator. Source: [OM-5 Mark II 1.1 system catalogue](../sources/omkit.system.md).
- **Physical camera** ([OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)): 0xa3470000..0xa3780000 pattern-tested word by word on the camera. Source: [OM-5 Mark II 1.1 system catalogue](../sources/omkit.system.md).
